title: westwell turns weakness into strength with soul-stirring new track “Fear”
htmlContent: westwell's most recent single, "Fear," is a quiet but powerful look at what it means to be human. It's a song and a prayer that talks about the struggle between being weak and being responsible. It demonstrates a shared aspiration to step up when life challenges us beyond our perceived capabilities. The song doesn't try to steer away from fear, but it uses it as a guide. "Fear" makes people think about things in a musical and thematic way. You don't have to get rid of fear or beat it, you just have to accept it as a normal part of being human. westwell takes a raw, personal feeling and turns it into a source of strength, a quiet fuel for becoming the person we want to be, for our kids, for each other, and for the future. https://open.spotify.com/track/0uB4K7a8aRZfD8DvoExYBy?si=8696513442814ffd The song has a quiet sense of urgency that comes from someone who is trying to improve the world while also dealing with their own problems. "Fear" has a hopeful tone that keeps it from feeling too heavy or hopeless. Instead, it becomes a song about having a purpose in life and wanting to face the challenges of it with courage, even when you are full of doubt and uncertainty. westwell gets that universal need to look back on our choices and know that we've done our best and been the person that history, or life itself, has called us to be. westwell's "Fear" is a very human experience that shows us that accepting fear doesn't make us weaker, it can make us do the most loving and brave things. It's a personal, reflective song for anyone who wants to be a better person in a world that isn't perfect. Follow westwell on Instagram
